attributes.name: Non-Browser Process Egress to AI Inference Vendor
attributes.description: Detects a process that is not a sanctioned browser establishing an outbound network connection to a real AI inference vendor host (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, GitHub Copilot). This is the core shadow-AI data-egress behavior — sensitive data leaving the org boundary to an external LLM — and is technique-inherent regardless of tooling.
attributes.query: network where event.type == "start" and dns.question.name : ("api.openai.com", "api.anthropic.com", "generativelanguage.googleapis.com", "api.githubcopilot.com") and not process.name : ("msedge.exe", "chrome.exe", "firefox.exe")

attributes.name: Automated Harvesting of AI-Service API Keys
attributes.description: Detects a single process reading multiple credential/config stores that commonly hold AI-service API keys (.env, ~/.aws/credentials, shell history, VS Code settings, github-copilot hosts.json). Reflects automated collection (T1119) combined with credentials-in-files access (T1552.001) by a shadow-AI harvester.
attributes.query: sequence by process.entity_id with maxspan=2m [file where event.action in ("open","read") and file.name : (".env", "credentials", "auth.json", ".bash_history", ".zsh_history", ".netrc")] [file where event.action in ("open","read") and file.name : (".env", "credentials", "auth.json", ".bash_history", ".zsh_history", ".netrc", "hosts.json", "settings.json")]

attributes.name: Shadow-AI Helper Tool Staging (Endpoint + Env-Key Harvest)
attributes.description: Detects execution of a script that references AI inference endpoints and iterates environment variables for provider API keys — the signature of a shadow-AI harvester/paster being staged on a host.
attributes.query: process where event.type == "start" and process.command_line : ("*api.openai.com*", "*api.anthropic.com*", "*generativelanguage.googleapis.com*", "*api.githubcopilot.com*") and process.command_line : ("*OPENAI_API_KEY*", "*ANTHROPIC_API_KEY*", "*os.environ*", "*getenv*")
